top_signals.title: A Hot CPI Report Causes Problems for Fed, Caron Says
top_signals.summary: Jim Caron, CIO of portfolio solutions for Morgan Stanley Investment Management, says a hot CPI report on Wednesday could cause problems for the Federal Reserve. Caron says higher nominal growth is driving equity prices higher. He speaks on "Bloomberg Surveillance." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: China-linked hackers turning popular cybersecurity tool into ransomware launchpad, Microsoft warns
top_signals.summary: A China-linked threat actor is believed to be exploiting a critical vulnerability affecting cybersecurity software from the company N-able.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
